numeric_boundary: Normative Seed objects use integers only; floating-point values are forbidden by the schemas.

rules.authority_binding_digest: SHA-256 of the ResolutionAuthorityBinding object with authority_binding_digest omitted.
rules.binding_digest: SHA-256 of the ResolutionBinding object with binding_digest omitted.
rules.grant_digest: SHA-256 of the AuthorityGrant object with grant_digest omitted.
rules.record_digest: SHA-256 of the ResolutionRecord object with record_digest omitted.
rules.request_digest: SHA-256 of the ResolutionRequest object with request_digest omitted.

unicode_boundary: Strings are canonicalized and hashed as RFC 8785 UTF-8 output.
